title: Continuous cohomology of profinite groups, Part II: Massey products and Galois lifting
summary: Build the continuous cochain and finite unipotent interfaces needed to interpret higher degree-one Massey products as Galois lifting problems. Develop the explicit stabilizer modules, conjugacy tests and refined local lifting theorem, including real places and rank-one twists. Construct the defined nonvanishing triple with Z/8 coefficients over Q, while importing foundational cohomology, embedding problems and arithmetic duality from their existing owners.
readme: The reader document research/blueprint/readmes/ProfiniteCohomologyPartII.md specifies every target, convention, supplier contract, API and discriminating check. This continuation owns Massey-specific continuous comparisons and unipotent calculations. Generic Massey products belong to DGAInfinity; global rational-point and number-field mod-p vanishing theorems belong to the homogeneous-space continuation. The independent negligible-class direction is assigned by the split proposal in the packet.

stages.title: Continuous cochains and degree-one defining systems
stages.description: Construct the strictly associative continuous inhomogeneous cochain DGA and its canonical cohomology comparison. Specialize DGAInfinity defining systems with d a_ij=−Σ a_im∪a_mj, retain their full set of H² values, and control changes of adjacent representatives.

stages.title: Unitriangular quotients and Dwyer correspondence
stages.description: Reuse the pinned upper-unitriangular carrier, transvections and filtration. Add their ordered factorization, reverse commutator inclusions, adjacent and corner quotient interfaces. Prove the fixed-cochain Dwyer bijection, its negative extension-class sign, definedness and zero-membership lift criteria.

stages.title: Abelianized stabilizers and explicit conjugation
stages.description: Identify B=(U¹)^ab with the distance-two and distance-three coordinates, compute its A-action and boundary submodule, and provide sparse-conjugation and reversal formulas with correct signs.

stages.title: Nilpotent support and outer exponents
stages.description: Expose the matrix-support calculation needed for power bounds; define the outer exponent literally by least divisor and prove the small-rank powering factorization. Keep the characteristic-three corner term and the characteristic-two least-divisor correction.

stages.title: Bogomolov vanishing for the derived stabilizer
stages.description: Define the Bogomolov restriction kernel and the commutativity-preserving exterior square. Establish their natural character duality and the endpoint-collection normal form for superdiagonal groups, yielding B_Bog(U¹)=0 without assuming the geometric unramified-Brauer comparison.

stages.title: Cyclic cohomology and fixed conjugacy classes
stages.description: Build the cyclic restriction kernel and the conjugacy-power evaluation test. Prove fixed second-diagonal lifts, boundary generation and dual cyclic-kernel vanishing. Establish full fixed-class generation for lengths four and five, retaining the central-commutator calculation.

stages.title: Sharpness and explicit obstruction modules
stages.description: Record the length-six failure and the nonzero length-four cyclic kernel. Construct the five-dimensional C₂×C₄×C₂ module, its cyclically trivial nonzero dual class and its auxiliary quartic cocycle, with formulas rather than a reference to an unspecified completion.

stages.title: Refined nonarchimedean lifting
stages.description: Construct the internal-sum boundary subgroup P_(r,s), its twisted finite module sequence and explicit retractions. Import the finite-domain splitting-class cup formula. Cancel the obstruction by local duality in the nonsplit case and extend a retraction over its stabilizer in the split case, proving Proposition 5.3.

stages.title: Real places and ordinary local vanishing
stages.description: Prove the finite C₂ duality needed at the real place and extend the refined theorem to every archimedean completion. Deduce ordinary degree-one local Massey vanishing at length at least three.

stages.title: Filtered modules and twisted Dwyer correspondence
stages.description: Specialize the strict continuous cochain model to finite Hom coefficient systems. Construct filtered block automorphisms, adjacent semidirect quotients and the noncentral-in-T corner extension. Prove the fixed-adjacent-cocycle bijection and sign, then derive representative-independent existence by conjugation; identify the rank-one internal-sum boundary.

stages.title: Rank-one twisted local lifting
stages.description: Kill the finite diagonal characters over a prime-to-p extension and compare obstructions by restriction/corestriction. Prove the rank-one twisted refined lifting theorem at all number-field places.

stages.title: The defined nonvanishing Z/8 triple over Q
stages.description: Starting from the existing independent cyclic-eight lifts, construct the UT₄(Z/8) coefficient modules, their dual Wang class and invariant-coordinate obstruction. Deduce a nonzero Sha² kernel and a middle character, prove its embedding problem solvable at every completion but not globally, and conclude Theorem 7.5 using the separate global definedness step.
